Ata dia partial screenshot o nite parben tasara full screen er screenshot o nite parben. Aro ase shortcut key o use korte chaile setao kore nite parben jemon (shift+print screen) (ctrl+shift) etc apnr posondo moto. Partial ba full screen no mattar duitai alada vabe keyboard a shortcut kore nite parben. (ধন্যবাদ)

Vai,apnar basic ei vul.Root Kore kunu din custom ROM use kora jay na. Custom ROM use korar prothom step holo Bootloader unlocking,2nd step holo apnar stock recovery ke replace Kore custom recovery bosano,3rd step holo oi custom recovery er maddhome custom ROM flash kora…eita hoilo giye custom ROM flash korar ekebare basic steps. Ar Device root kora holo completely different thing.Root apni apnar stock ROM e thekew korte parben abar custom ROM e thekew korte parben(Custom recovery must needed in this case) So root korar Sathe custom ROM er kunu somporko nai.
Aro kichu boli,Stock ROM er Sathe custom ROM er tulona Kore lav nei,duitar purpose e alada.Dekhen stock ROM build Kore sadaronoto aam jonotar jonno, jate Kore sob dhoroner user ra ROM comfortably use korte pare.ar custom ROM build kora hoy with a complete different intentions,kew chay onno device er feel dite,kew chay performance barate,kew chay battery backup/daily life e mobile er overall experience enhance korte.Ar bug er Kotha bollen,bug Vai sob ROM ei thake,stock/custom differentiate korar sujog nei.Custom ROM community te ghuraghuri koren,tailei bujben. ?

sorok durghotna ken?_x000D_ _x000D_ oneke bolen bicarhintar karne sorok durghotna. ami mani na. bicarhinta durghotnar chotto ongosh matro. Bichar joti kothin hok na ken sorok durghotna thakbei? matro bochor khanek ageo et durghotna hot na. bishesh kore dhaka shohore chite fota holeo sheta ekhonkar moto mohamari chil na. ekhon ken?_x000D_ _x000D_ karon motor shrmikder upor sorkarke upekkha kore madok sebon ebong malik o cadabajder capiye deya takar khorgo. ek dike malikra prtidin mota ongker taka joma neya onjdike cadabajra bivinno khate mota ongker cada aday kore . e sob metate giye shrmikder vor 5 ta theke rat 12 ta porjonto biramhin omanobik khatuni khatte hoy ebong kar age ke jatri dhorbe tar prtijogita o probontao bere jay. tar upor oye bil o siting sarvise shuvongokrer faki ache jar madhjme shrmikder barti kamai ase. sohoj kothay bolte gele apni sodor ghat theke uttra jaben vara 40 taka. apni mohakhali namleo collish taka dite hobe abar okhan theke oi sit khali jay na onno ekjon tule ney jakeo 40 taka ba 30 taka dite hoy. eki gontobje otirikto kamai (40+30)70 - 40 30 taka. tar upor oi siting garigulo lokaler moti lok tole jader varao siting er moto eki. ei faki ache bole malikra otirikto joma ney ebong cadakhorrao otirikto aday kore. jar fole shrmikra nirupay hoye ek dike otirikto rojgarer anondo onjdike malik o cadakhorder cape ebong madker taka jogate tara beproya hoye jay. jar mashul gunte hoy jatrider poket theke ebong pothcarider rokto theke. jara bolen bicarhintar karne sorok durghotna hoy tara esi garite cole. mul rohossho jane na ba janleo sbikar kore na kore bivranto poth dekhay. karon ekdike tara cadar vag pay onjdike se nije ba tar atmiy sbojon poribohner malik bole. ar tarai shrmikder majhe sukoushle madok choriye dey._x000D_ _x000D_ tai ami mone kori madok, oyebil o siting namok sorkar oghoshit poddhtir poriborton na hole sorke morok portei thakbe. ar ei poddhti calu thakle jatrider poket kata o hoyrani ebong durghotnar dayvar sorkar o malikder ghare bortay. shrmikder noy._x000D_ _x000D_ boltei hoy ei oyebil o siting sarvis namok sorkar ononumodit poddhtir karne jonogne sorke voganti pohay._x000D_ sorkarer ucit ei poddhti poribortne kothor hoya._x000D_ _x000D_ ruhul amin._x000D_ 02:08:2018_x000D_ skal 09:00_x000D_ dhaka.

Noyon Chatterjee Returned ‘lal golap’ namti shunle oneker mone pore jay Shofik rehmaner nam. tar asol nam shofikur rohman, kintu britene giye hoye jay Shofik rehman. Shofik rehmanke onek somoy lal sharto porihit obosthay dekha jeto. kintu ken Shofik Rehman lash sharto porto, ar tar onushthaner nam-i ba ken lal gopal rakhlo ?? poshcima bishbe lal top ba rokto lal golap eki seimbol bohon kore. lal sharto ba lal top hocche poshcima bishbe somkamita totha ge’ kalcarer prtik. abar lal golapo eki prtik bohon kore. red roj ba lal golap namey poshcima bishbe somkamider series uponjas khub jonopriy. muloto bangladesher shei bikrit jounmansiktar seimbol amdanite rot chilea Shofik rehman. hotel intar-kontinentale ekauntento hisabe kormoroto thaka kale sie shofiker biruddhe ek kormcari somkamitar ovijog tole bole shona jay. Shofik Rehman ek somoy bibisir sangbadik chilo. porobortite se shuru kore jayjaydin ba moucake thil namok coti sahitjo. tar oshesh prceshtar fole bangladeshe prbesh kore ‘vjalentain de’ namok poshcima oshlil songoskriti. 2006 saler jun mase ‘saptahik jayjaydin’ potrikay diner por din kolame arbi okhor ‘alif’ ebong ‘oyao’-ke purushangger sathe tulna korechilo Shofik rehman, eta niye oi somoy besh andolon korechilo islami netara. 2011 saler 25she february ekti doinik potrikay kolam likhte giye ‘canso muhammod’ namok bisheshon bjobhar korechilo Shofik rehman. musolmander shesh nobike niye kotuktir karne oi bochri tar namey dhormiy onuvutite aghat daner jonjo mamlao hoyechilo. kothay bole, ‘pape chare na bape’. sobkichur ekta porismapti ache. Shofik rehmaner kkhetreo hoyto shei porismaptir somoy choley eseche. kobir vashay- 'dine dine bohu bariyache dena, sudhite hibe rin' | sobaike dhonjbad.

2 lkho koti taka " Bangladesh Bank" er rijarve pore ache. koyekdin age ekti sonamodhonjo potrikay hedlaine eseche khoborti. ami prothome vebechilam gajar dam ki sosta hoye gelo naki. sorkar naki et taka kothay khoroch korbe vebe pacche na. amra ei taka diye et et flaiovar cai na. durniti amader ogrogtite prothom badha ekhon. ektibar ki keu vebe dekhechi amader desher sorkar gulo amader ki diyeche aj pojornto.ekti desher ogrogtir jonjo dorkar sotta ar shikkhiter har barano. aj jodi shikkha vata, bekar vata,bidhba vata,boyosko vata ei deshe sorkar jodi calu korto onnanno unnoyner pashapashi amra onnanno desher moto egiye jete partam. ekti gorib chele-meye jatiy unnoyne vumika rakhte parto. somaj theke kishor opradh, curi, chintaikari, poket mar,khun,rahajani sobkichui kome jeto. sob unnot deshe eisob vata calu ache jate keu oporadh korme joriye na jay. daridrjta sob opradher samil. peter daye manush sobkichui kore. bigot koyek bochor dhorei to dekhchi shudhu biddut utpadon baracche amar desh. bakita amader jonogon i jane unnoyner joyar amader kotkhani vasiye niye jacche. age desher manushke shikkhito ar deshoprem shikhano hok. taropor jatir unnoyon emnitei hobe. evabe P.S.C ar J.S.C diye lovdekhano sakhorta na dekhiye shikkha vata calu korun. ar sathe bekarder jonjo kormososthan baran ar Income tax er upor jor din. desh emnitei egiye jabe. ta nahle 200 bochreo amra pichiye thakbo. du:kher kotha ei je, amra eivabe citkar korte thakbo ar uprer mohler gulo amader eivabe shoshon kore jabe. keu jatiy somossha niye andolon korbe na :( :( :(

brabor, manoniyo prdhanomontri gonoprjatontri Bangladesh sorkar. manoniyo prdhanomontri, ami apnar sbopner dijital bangladesher sbopno buke lalonkari ekjon sadharon chatro. shot sohosro asha ebong desher prti ek okrittim valobasa ebong nijeke desher jonjo jogjo kore gore tolar ek tibro akangkkha niye vorti hoyechilam apnar nij hatey prtishthit desher onjotom bishbbidjaloy joshor biggan o projukti bishbbidjaloye. ekti dijital Bangladesh gorte e dhoroner ekti projukti bishbbidjaloy prtishtha kora ni:osondehe apnar desh poricalnar ekti bickhoontar poricoy bohon kore. apni joshor basir sbopner ei prtishthane shot shot koti taka biniyog korechen duhat ujar kore. kintu otjonto du:kher sathe shei bishbbidjaloy jibner sucnalogno theke onuvob korchi je, onek paoyar anonde jokhon shikkharthider monopran ujar kore poralekha korar kotha, tar biprite ei komolomti shikkharthira soda dinatipat korche pran nasher humki, shliltahanir glani, ar chatrotto batil hoyar humki niye. sommanit shikhokder ke marte jaoya, gola kete felar humki, pran nasher humki, kotukti kora aj ekhane niymit ghotna. manoniyo prdhanomontri jekhane shikkharthira shikhokder pitamatar moto somman kore tader samne ekjon coturtho shrenir kormcarir dbara shikhokder niymit emon ghotnar shikar howa amader dijital bangladesher shopne jen pak hanadar bahinir moto hana diye jay. jokhon cokher samne amar chatri boner sliltahanir ceshta kora hoy, ar protibad korte giye bohishkar hote hoy shikkharthider tokhon mone hoy shei vasha andolon ar muktijuddher bivishikamoy din gulor kotha. apnar sushasner bangladeshe emon ekti adorsho bishbbidjaloye, bishbbidjaloyer proshashoner posha sontrasi madok bjabsayi, shikhokder lancit kora, chatrder jibon niye chinimini khela, ebong chatrider lancit korar je birol nojir sthapon koreche ta apnar amader sbopner sonar bangla gorar sompurno poriponthi. manoniyo prdhanomontri hajar hajar shikhok, shikkharthir milit artnade aj joshorer akash batas prokompit, bosrer por bosor ekjon kormcari proshashoner chotrchayay emon onjay kore jacche tar prtikar ki ajo hobe na?? jibner sonali somoy gulo choley jacche class porikkha na diye, joshor bishbbidjaloy bondho dui soptah jabot. ar kottuku somoy perole amra notun surjo dekhob? ar koto shikhok lancit hole, chatri lancit hole, chatrder jibon biponno hole apnar sahajjo pab?? onugroh kore amader sbopno gulo bacate egiye asun. apnar sudrishtir poth pane ceye din gunchi amra. binit mo: nasir uddin badol jin prkoushol o jib projukti bivag joshor biggan o projukti bishbbidjaloy.

rashtro o rashtrodhormo rashtrer moulik upadan 4ti. 1. jonosomoshti. 2. nirdishto vukhondo. 3. sorkar. 4.sarbvoumotbo. orthat kothao e carti jiniser somonboy paowa gelei take rashtro bola hobe. e carti upadaner mul kendrbindu holo prothomti orthat jonosomoshti. jonosomoshtike ghirei rashter onjosob ayojon. jonogner pryojnei rashtro ain pronoyon kore. rashtrer jonogner songoskritii rashtrer songoskriti. rashto ekti songogothon. er kono hat-pa nei. rashtrer kono mukh nei. rashtro kotha bolte pare na. ei juktite rashtrer kono vashar pryojon hoyar proshni othe na. kintu rashtrer sobceye boro upadan jonosomoshti vasha bjobhar kore, tader vasha ache bolei rashtrero vasha ache. jonogner vashai rashtrer vasha ba rashtrvasha. temni rashtro namaj porte pare na. rakhe na roja. korte pare na puja. rashtro nije bordino palon korte pare na. tahole rashtrer dhormo thakbe ken? er uttro thik agertir motoi. rashtrer jonosomoshtir dhormo ache bolei rashtreo dhormo thakbe. odhikangosh nagrik je dhorme bishbas kore. je dhormoke lalon kore. se dhormi to rashtrer dhormo. bortman bangladeshe 39ti vasha proclit ebong sobokti vashai jibit. kintu bangladesher songbidhane rashtrvasha cakma, saotali, garo, tippera, monipuri na hoye bangla rashtrvasha holo ete onjvashagulor morjadahani hoyeche? songbidhaner prothom vager 3-e bola hoyeche ‘prjatontrer rashtrvasha bangla’৷ ekhane onno kono vashar kotha ullekh kora hoyni. kintu songbidhaner prothom vager jekhane rashtrodhormer kotha ache sekhane bola hoyeche, ‘prjatontrer rashtrodhormo islam, tobe hindu, bouddho, khrishtanosoh onnanno dhormo palne rashtro somomorjada o somodhikar nishcit koriben’. vashar bepare onno vashavashider somomorjadar kotha ullekh kora hoyni othoc dhormer kkhetre onjosob dhormabolombider somomorjadar kotha ullekh kore deya hoyeche. eteo ki tader odhikar nishcit hoyni? naki 90% musolmaner dhormer prtii tader mul bidbesh? 09% hinduder dhormoke rashtrodhormo korte parlei tader atma khushi hobe?jodi rashtrodhormo Hindu hoto tahole ki ajker oisob buddhijibi(!)ra kono proshno korten? rashtrodhormo Islam thakle somosjata ki? islami ki ekmatro unnoyner ontray? rashtrodhormo theke islamke bad dilei ki bangladesher kromobordhman khun, dhorshon, bjangok kjalengkari, chintai bondho hoye jabe? rashtrodhormo Islam thakle onno dhormabolombider ki kono somossha hocche? na. somosjata onno jaygay. rashtrodhormo kono unnoyner ontray noy borong hijab, ajan, korbani nishiddho korar pothe ekti boro badha. ei badhati dur kora gelei kamal pashar moto hijab, ajan, prkashje jamate namaj bondho kora jabe. adalotke mone rakhte hobe, rashtrvashar jonjo je jati pran diye bishbe nojir sthapon korte pare se jati rashtrodhormo rkkhar jonjo pran dite soda prostut. rashtrvashar jonjo 5 jon pran dite parle 5 lakh salam, borokot, rofik, jobbar shofiurra prostut ache.
hlud sangbadikta kore jara tader evabe sbadhinta o mohan muktijuddho niye kono kotha bola manay na. muktijuddhke niye vondami kora charun.

tnui ekmatro tonu noy, aro tonu ache. 26she marco 45tom mohan sbadhinta dibse prdhanomontri shekh hasinar prti: kkhove uttal kumilla! obilombe kumilla bivagti gothon korun =========================================== kumilla viktoriya sorkari kolejer itihas bivager snatok (somman) ditio borsher chatri o natjokormi sohagi jahan tonuke dhorshon sheshe hotja kora hoy. kalvarter pasher jonggole matha thetlano sohagir ordhonogno mritdeh uddhar kora hoy. ghotnay joritder obilombe greftar o tader Bichar dabite kkhove uttal hoye utheche kumilla nogri. edike tonur barite colche tar baba-ma o sbojonder ahajari. kumilla viktoriya kolej, sorkari mohila kolejosoh nogrir bivinno shikkha prtishthaner dol nibisheshe hajar hajar shikkharthisoh bivinno samajik o sangoskritik songogothner neta-kormira mathe nemeche. shikkharthisoh prtibadi jonota nogrite dofay dofay bikkhov michil sheshe dupure kandirpar pubali cottbre eshe manobobondhon o somabesh kore. rajdhani dhakasoh desher bivinno sthane e niye got car dine bikkhov o protibad somabesh kora hocche. fesbukeo biche prtibader jhor. 64ti jela gothner pore prostabomot bangladeshke 9ti bivage bivokto na koray rashtr-obkathamo shithil-sontrasmukhi hoy. ete sontrasbadi-onoitik cetna kromobordhman hoy. Khaleda jiya ordhshikkhit o kombujh prdhanomontri. tini na hoy borishal o silet bivag gothon kore baki tinti bivag gothon korlen na. ar bar bar bola sotteo shikkhito o bujh prdhanomontri shekh hasina 1997-e iuniyonke 9ti oyarde bivoktir sathe sathe bangladeshke 9ti bivage bivokto korlen na. bar bar bolay pach bochor pore moyomonsingoh bivag korlen. bigot satobochrer prdhanomontri shekh hasinar sorkaramle prbriddhir ghor har prai 6.2% chil. agami bochor prbriddhir har 7.0% upre hobe. agami bochor prdhanomontri shekh hasina bar bar shunaben, ami prbriddhir ghor har 7.0% tulechi ja jatir itihas. eisathe kumilla bivagtio hole prbriddhir ghor har kromosho: 7.8%-er upre hoto. prdhanomontri shekh hasinao bar bar e kotha shunate parten na? kumilla bivagti ekhno baki ache. bangladeshke 8ti bivage bivoktir pore ekhon ar ekti bivager jonje kon prvabshil andolon hobe na. othoc kumilla bivag gothner jonje barshik bjoy barbe matro carketi taka. bangladeshke 9ti bivage bivokto kora holei rashtr-obkathamo sushom-gonotontrmukhi hobe.sokolkkhetre udar, noitik o srijonshil cetna bikasher dhara debe. prbriddhi gorhar 1.0% briddhisoh jatir nirapotta o unnoyner dhara barbe. ekhon joruri vittite baki kumilla bivagti korun.

71 tivi o fresh brjander sokol ponjo borjon korun, fresh thakun.... bangladesher prodhan Islam bidbeshi media holo ekattor tivi. Awamiponthi sangbadik mojammel babu 71 tivi shuru korar por 2013 sale meghna gruper kache 0.51 share bikri kore dey. shurur dik thekei 71 tivi prochondo Islam bidbeshi vumika palon kore asche. utsah dey nastikder bivinno kormkander. got koyekdin dhore rashtrodhormo Islam niye 71 tivi kichu toksho ayojon kore. shei tokshogulote protjkhojvabe Islam jen rashtrodhormo na thake shei jonjo bivinno dhormhin lokderke tokshote ene Islam bidbeshi monovab procondvabe prokash korte thake. 71 tivi sob somoyi alem olamader hey korar ceshtay thake. eivabe prtiniyti meghna gruper malikanadhin 71 tivi islamer biruddhe obosthan niye asche. ekjon muslim hisebe apnar amar imani dbayitbo holo 71 tivi soh eder ponjo borjon kora. meghna gruper ullekhjogjo brjando holo fresh. fresh brjander kono ponjo kine muloto apni 71 tivikei taka dicchen. cinta korun apnar takay 71 tivi Islam bidbeshi vumika palon korche. ashun nije o islamke fresh rakhte fresh bjando borjon kori.

rashtro o rashtrodhormo rashtrer moulik upadan 4ti. 1 jonosomoshti. 2 nirdishto vukhondo. 3 sorkar. 4.sarbvoumotbo. orthat kothao e carti jiniser somonboy paowa gelei take rashtro bola hobe. e carti upadaner mul kendrbindu holo prothomti orthat jonosomoshti. jonosomoshtike ghirei rashter onjosob ayojon. jonogner pryojnei rashtro ain pronoyon kore. rashtrer jonogner songoskritii rashtrer songoskriti. rashto ekti songogothon. er kono hat-pa nei. rashtrer kono mukh nei. rashtro kotha bolte pare na. ei juktite rashtrer kono vashar pryojon hoyar proshni othe na. kintu rashtrer sobceye boro upadan jonosomoshti vasha bjobhar kore, tader vasha ache bolei rashtrero vasha ache. jonogner vashai rashtrer vasha ba rashtrvasha. temni rashtro namaj porte pare na. rakhe na roja. korte pare na puja. rashtro nije bordino palon korte pare na. tahole rashtrer dhormo thakbe ken? er uttro thik agertir motoi. rashtrer jonosomoshtir dhormo ache bolei rashtreo dhormo thakbe. odhikangosh nagrik je dhorme bishbas kore. je dhormoke lalon kore. se dhormi to rashtrer dhormo. bortman bangladeshe 39ti vasha proclit ebong sobokti vashai jibit. kintu bangladesher songbidhane rashtrvasha cakma, saotali, garo, tippera, monipuri na hoye bangla rashtrvasha holo ete onjvashagulor morjadahani hoyeche? songbidhaner prothom vager 3-e bola hoyeche ‘prjatontrer rashtrvasha bangla’৷ ekhane onno kono vashar kotha ullekh kora hoyni. kintu songbidhaner prothom vager jekhane rashtrodhormer kotha ache sekhane bola hoyeche, ‘prjatontrer rashtrodhormo islam, tobe hindu, bouddho, khrishtanosoh onnanno dhormo palne rashtro somomorjada o somodhikar nishcit koriben’. vashar bepare onno vashavashider somomorjadar kotha ullekh kora hoyni othoc dhormer kkhetre onjosob dhormabolombider somomorjadar kotha ullekh kore deya hoyeche. eteo ki tader odhikar nishcit hoyni? naki 0.9 musolmaner dhormer prtii tader mul bidbesh? 0.09 hinduder dhormoke rashtrodhormo korte parlei tader atma khushi hobe?jodi rashtrodhormo Hindu hoto tahole ki ajker oisob buddhijibi(!)ra kono proshno korten? rashtrodhormo Islam thakle somosjata ki? islami ki ekmatro unnoyner ontray? rashtrodhormo theke islamke bad dilei ki bangladesher kromobordhman khun, dhorshon, bjangok kjalengkari, chintai bondho hoye jabe? rashtrodhormo Islam thakle onno dhormabolombider ki kono somossha hocche? na. somosjata onno jaygay. rashtrodhormo kono unnoyner ontray noy borong hijab, ajan, korbani nishiddho korar pothe ekti boro badha. ei badhati dur kora gelei kamal pashar moto hijab, ajan, prkashje jamate namaj bondho kora jabe. adalotke mone rakhte hobe, rashtrvashar jonjo je jati pran diye bishbe nojir sthapon korte pare se jati rashtrodhormo rkkhar jonjo pran dite soda prostut. rashtrvashar jonjo 5 jon pran dite parle 5 lakh salam, borokot, rofik, jobbar shofiurra prostut ache.

11:114ar tumi salat kayem kor dibser du’prante ebong raater prothom ongshe. nishchoi valkaj mondkajke mitiye dey. eti updesh grohonkarider jonjo updesh.24:58 he muminogon, tomader danhat jar malik hoyeche ebong tomader moddhe jara praptoboyosko hoyni tara jen oboshji tin somye onumti grohon kore. fojrer salater purbe, dupure jokhon tomra tomader poshak khule rakh, ebong ‘ishar salater por; ei tinti tomader somoy. ei tin somoyer por tomader ebong tader kon dosh nei. tomader eke onjer kache jatayat kortei hoy. evabe Allah tomader uddeshje tar ayatosmuh bornna koren. Allah mohajnani, projnamoy.17:78 surjo hele porar somoy theke raater ondhkar porjonto salat kayem kor ebong fojrer kuran. nishcoy fojrer kuran (fereshtader) uposthitir somoy.2:238 tomra salatosmuh o modhjoborti salater hifajot kor ebong allahor jonjo darao binit hoye.62:9 he muminogon, jokhon jumu‘ar dine salater jonjo ahoban kora hoy, tokhon tomra allahor smorner dike dhabit ho. ar beca-kena borjon kor. etai tomader jonjo sorbottom, jodi tomra jante. .9:54 ar tader dan kobul theke ekmatro badha ei chil je, tara Allah o tar rasulke osbikar koreche, ar tara salate ase na, tobe olos obosthay ebong tara dan kore na, tobe opochondkari obosthay.20:130sutrang era ja bole tar upor dhoirjo dharon kor ebong tasbih path kor tomar rober proshongsa bornnar madhjme, surjodyer purbe, surjaster purbe ebong tasbih path kor raater kichu ongshe o diner prantosmuhe, jate tumi sontushto hote par.21:73 ar taderke ami neta baniyechilam, tara amar nirdesh onusare manushke sothik poth dekhat. ami tader prti sotkaj korar, salat kayem korar ebong jakat prodan korar jonjo ohi preron korechilam. ar tara amari ibadat korot.7:205 ar tumi nij mone apon robke smoron kor sokal-sondhjay onunoy-binoy o viti sohkare ebong onucco sbre. ar gafelder ontorvukto hoyo na.30:17 oteb tomra allahor tasbih kor, jokhon sondhjay upnit hobe ebong sokale uthbe .30:18 ar oprahne o juhrer somye; ar asman o jomine sokol proshongsa ekmatro tari.38:18 ami porbotmalake onugot korechilam, tar sathe egulo sokal-sondhjay amar tasbih path korot.50:39 oteb era ja bole, tate tumi dhoirjdharon kor ebong surjo udyer purbe o ostmit hoyar purbe tumi tomar rober proshongsasoh tasbih path kor.50:40 ebong raater ekangsheo tumi tar tasbih path kor ebong salater poshcateo.29:45 tomar prti je kitab ohi kora hoyeche, ta theke tilaoyat kor ebong salat kayem kor. nishcoy salat oshlil o mondkaj theke birot rakhe. ar allahor smorni to sorboshreshtho. Allah janen ja tomra kor.22:26amar ghorke pak saf rakhbe taoyafkari, ruku-sijda o dariye salat adaykarir jonj’.22:77 he muminogon, tomra ruku‘ kor, sijda kor, tomader rober ibadat kor ebong val kaj kor, asha kora jay tomra sofol hote parbe.22:78. eta tomader pita ibrahimer din. tinii tomader nam rekhechen ‘muslim’ purbe ebong e kitabeo. jate rasul tomader jonjo sakkhi hoy ar tomra manusher jonjo sakkhi ho. oteb tomra salat kayem kor, jakat dao ebong allahke mojbutvabe dhor. tinii tomader ovivabok. ar tini koti na uttom ovivabok ebong koti na uttom sahajjkari! 17:110 bol tomra (tomader robke)allah’ namey dak othoba ‘rahman’ namey dak, je namei tomra dak na ken, tar jonji to royeche shundor namosmuh. tumi tomar salate sbor ucu koro na ebong tate mriduo koro na; borong er majhamajhi poth obolombon kor.///

erokom gurutor opradher shasti moukuf kono vabei grohon jogjo na. 1. emon onicchakrit biyer por opradhi je sujog pele abar gurutor kono oporadh korbe na tar ki gjaranti ache? ete viktimke saper gorte fele deyar motoi Bichar holo. ar onicchakrit biye kora strir (kajer meyer) prti opradhi ar tar poribarer acoron kemon hobe ta sohjei onumey. ar nijer prti julum kora dhorshokkei nijer jamai mene neyar caite kharap kichu hote pare na. ei obosthay oshay meyegulo nijer ar sontaner vobishjter kotha cinta kore raji hoye geleo tara kokhono mon theke ei onjay/opradh vule jete pare na. 2. ei opradhi soh onno somvabjo opradhira ekhon bujhe gelo je dhorshon korle temon voyer kichu nai. karon jodi Bichar shesh porjonto hoyi, tobe biye kore nilei khalas. 3. biye bishoytai kono shasti na, borong manusher prti allahor ek dhoroner puroskar. 4. islame dhorshoner shasti mritjudondo. biyer binimye maf pabar kono sujog nai. viktim biyer binimye maf korleo shasti komay deya jete pare, kintu puroi maf kora kono vabei grohonjogjo na. ete ete somajer onno meyeder nirapottar khoti hoy.

The company is also one of the leading mobile phone manufacturers in bangladesh. Waltons mobile phones are known for their high quality, affordable prices, and stylish designs. The company offers a wide range of models to choose from, including budgetfriendly options and highend flagships. Some of the popular walton mobile phones include the primo x2, primo zx, primo x3, and primo z. These phones are equipped with advanced features such as highresolution displays, powerful processors, and longlasting batteries. Walton also offers a wide range of accessories for its mobile phones, such as cases, chargers, and headphones. The company also provides aftersales service for its products.
